meaning:
ἄ-μεμπτος, -ον
(μέμφομσι), [in LXX chiefly for תָּם ;]
blameless, free from fault (in π. of a marriage-contract; M, Th., I, 3:13; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Luk.1:6, Php.2:15 3:6, 1Th.3:13 (WH, mg., -ως) Heb.8:7.†
SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος, which see (Tr., Syn., § ciii) (AS)

elsewhere.note: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as…
to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
